info.scriptSrcText: property thisNum, thisglobal gLevel, gLockOuton beginSprite  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  thisNum = the currentSpriteNum  this.blend = 50  this.locZ = the currentSpriteNumendon exitFrame  if thisNum = the rollover then    this.blend = 100  else    this.blend = 50  end ifendon mouseUp  case thisNum of    8:      gLevel = 1      go("Level" & gLevel)      puppetSound(2, member(12, "Sfx"))    9:      gLevel = 2      go("Level" & gLevel)      puppetSound(2, member(12, "Sfx"))    10:      gLevel = 3      go("Level" & gLevel)      puppetSound(2, member(12, "Sfx"))    11:      if integer(gLockOut) > 0 then        gLevel = 4        go("Level" & gLevel)        puppetSound(2, member(12, "Sfx"))      else        puppetSound(2, member(13, "Sfx"))        sprite(19).blend = 0      end if    12:      if integer(gLockOut) > 0 then        gLevel = 5        go("Level" & gLevel)        puppetSound(2, gLevel = 7        go("Level" & gLevel)        puppetSound(2, member(12, "Sfx"))      else        puppetSound(2, member(13, "Sfx"))        sprite(20).blend = 0      end if    15:      if integer(gLockOut) > 1 then        gLevel = 8        go("Level" & gLevel)        puppetSound(2, member(12, "Sfx"))      else        puppetSound(2, member(13, "Sfx"))        sprite(20).blend = 0
